name: hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw-g1-COMMIT
purpose: OWNERS-HBM/VM-GLUE 2026-10-18 (HBM d4g plan (b), top-down contract: glue goes into a hardened tile): VM hub glue tile for NW (hb_vms_NW) = ot_vms_hub_static + 2 ot_vms_rstop_static + ot_vms_rcl_static + ot_vms_status_static, the 8 banks hoisted to die-level instances (gen_vms_hoist.py / HBM-B-RTL1 qb glue, logic unchanged). Tile top hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t (gen_vms_glue_tiles.py): one clock (clk_hub/clk_ring/clk_replay are one stream clock), per-bank bank ports. Every port lands on / leaves from a flop except bank_status (status OR / CE adder rungs, as the slice) and the xq_done fault compare.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_tiles.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/hfd_hgi_vms_static_glue.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_hub_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_rstop_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_rcl_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_status_static.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
